project.title: The Neon Cat
project.style: Cinematic neon-noir, teal-magenta palette, volumetric rain and fog, soft bloom, anamorphic lens, shallow depth of field, film grain

scenes.heading: INT. NEON CITY ALLEY - NIGHT
scenes.description:
Rain pours down in sheets, neon lights reflecting off the wet asphalt. A sleek mechanical cat with glowing blue eyes steps cautiously through a puddle.

The cat pauses, its ears twitching as it detects a signal.

In the city that never sleeps, one cat searches for what was taken from it.

The cat leaps onto a dumpster, scanning the alley with infrared vision.

scenes.heading: EXT. ROOFTOP - NIGHT
scenes.description:
The cat bounds across rooftops, silhouetted against the massive holographic billboard. The city stretches endlessly below.

Memories. Stolen by the ones who built it.

The cat reaches the edge of a building and looks down at a heavily guarded corporate tower.

scenes.heading: INT. CORPORATE TOWER LOBBY - NIGHT
scenes.description:
Sleek chrome and glass. Security drones patrol the corridors. The cat slips through an air vent, moving silently.

All clear on level 12.

The cat drops from the ceiling behind the guard and continues deeper into the building.

scenes.heading: INT. MEMORY VAULT - NIGHT
scenes.description:
A vast chamber filled with glowing data crystals. Each one contains stolen memories. The cat finds the crystal with a faint blue glow matching its own eyes.

The cat touches the crystal with its paw. Memories flood back - a child laughing, a warm home, the smell of rain.

And in that moment, it remembered everything.

The cat grabs the crystal and runs, alarms blaring behind it.

scenes.heading: EXT. CITY SKYLINE - DAWN
scenes.description:
The cat sits on the highest rooftop, crystal safely tucked under its paw. The sun rises over the neon city, painting everything in gold.

Some things are worth fighting for. Even if you're just a cat.

FADE OUT.

shots.shotStory: We establish the gritty, soaked atmosphere of the city and the precise, weighted movement of our protagonist. The splash disrupts the neon reflections, grounding the mechanical being in the physical world.

shots.description: A tight focus on the cat's face as it freezes, ears twitching mechanically to process a sound.
